guadalupe-river-flood.label: Historical river stage at Kerrville
guadalupe-river-flood.note: The one-hour model is evaluated at this gauge. The map point represents a stage forecast, with no modeled flood extent.

hubbard-landslides.label: Glacier monitoring sites
hubbard-landslides.note: These reference points locate nearby slopes and glacier runouts for repeat checks. The points mark landmarks used to find the area in NASA imagery.

markers.name: Mount King George
markers.detail: Review nearby slopes and the glacier below them for new debris.

markers.name: McArthur Peak
markers.detail: Check whether deposits visible in the radar pair persist on a later pass.

krasheninnikov-eruption.label: Lava-flow monitoring direction
krasheninnikov-eruption.note: The arrow indicates where the published radar sequence shows lava spreading from the northern crater. Its length is schematic. If effusion continues, compare new imagery in that direction.

markers.name: Krasheninnikov reference point
markers.detail: Monitor the eastern flow margin. Arrow shows the observed eastward direction.

la-guaira-earthquakes.label: Post-earthquake monitoring site
la-guaira-earthquakes.note: The site marks where to check repeat radar observations for continued ground movement. The NISAR layer shows measured June 2026 line-of-sight displacement.

markers.name: Maiquetía airport area
markers.detail: NASA identified the section near the airport as an area of significant displacement. Compare with a later interferogram.
